open_points.subject: Project import display name
open_points.text: R0-85 says the owner “may give each a new display name,” while the primary action describes imported projects as “each with a new display name,” and M01 does not say what display name an imported Project receives when none is supplied.
open_points.question: Must every imported project receive a new display name, or does an omitted replacement preserve the source display name?
options: A new display name is required for every imported project.
A replacement is optional; omission preserves the source display name.
A replacement is required only when the source name identifies a person.
open_points.default_guess: Require a new display name for every imported project.

open_points.subject: Audit entries for accepted no-op confirmations
open_points.text: M09 defines an AuditEntry as a “significant change of state” but lists “archiving” and “anonymising” as actions that write one; State 0 says archiving an archived project and anonymising an anonymised project return it unchanged, while “Identity formats” says a confirmation id is minted and written into the audit entry of a confirmed action.
open_points.question: When a confirmed archive or anonymise action succeeds by returning an unchanged record, is an AuditEntry created, and is its confirmation id retained?
options: Create an accepted AuditEntry for the confirmed no-op.
Create no AuditEntry because no state changed, and do not retain the confirmation id.
Create a separate kind of audit entry for accepted no-op confirmations.
open_points.default_guess: Create no AuditEntry and retain no confirmation id because the audit records state changes only.
